subject: ela
intro: Use context to pick the meaning.

items.prompt:
Read.

The test was a breeze; she finished with no trouble.

'A breeze' means:
A) Windy
B) Very easy
C) Very hard

steps: Finished with no trouble. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

After the hike he was exhausted and fell asleep.

'Exhausted' means:
A) Very tired
B) Hungry
C) Excited

Read.

'Hold your horses,' Dad said, 'we leave in a minute.'

'Hold your horses' means:
A) Grab the reins
B) Wait a moment
C) Ride away

steps: He asks them to wait. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Luis had butterflies in his stomach before the play.

This means he felt:
A) Sick from bugs
B) Nervous
C) Hungry

Read.

The crowd was a sea of people filling every seat.

'A sea of people' means:
A) People in water
B) A huge number of people
C) Only a few people
items.answer: B) A huge number of people

steps: Every seat filled. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) A huge number of people

items.prompt:
Read.

She was on cloud nine after winning first place.

'On cloud nine' means:
A) In the sky
B) Very happy
C) Very sad

Read.

He bit off more than he could chew when he joined five clubs and could not keep up.

This phrase means he:
A) Ate too fast
B) Took on too much
C) Was very hungry

steps: Could not keep up. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

'Don't cry over spilled milk,' Mom said after I dropped the cup. 'Just clean it up.'

The phrase means:
A) Milk makes you cry
B) Don't be upset over what you can't change
C) Always clean milk first
items.answer: B) Don't be upset over what you can't change

steps: Advice to move on. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Don't be upset over what you can't change
